E4Plus1.uk.description: Gordon Ramsay transforms Shanty on 19th, an iconic restaurant in the West End theatre district of Allentown, Pennsylvania, into a bright and airy contemporary bistro. (S2 Ep2)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Ramsay's 24 Hours to Hell and Back
E4Plus1.uk.description: Gordon visits Vasi's Restaurant and Bar, a family-owned eatery in Waterbury, Connecticut, to remodel the dated interior into an inviting Mediterranean seaside taverna. (S2 Ep3)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Sound of Bleeding Gums: Lisa meets Bleeding Gums Murphy's deaf son Monk, and decides she has to help him - whether he wants help or not. (S33 Ep17)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: My Octopus and a Teacher: Bart becomes infatuated with his new teacher. Lisa becomes infatuated with an octopus. (S33 Ep18)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Blazed and Confused: Bart tricks his family into going to a strange desert festival known as Blazing Guy so that he can get revenge on his sadistic new teacher, Mr Lassen. (S26 Ep7/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Dante's Peak
E4Plus1.uk.description: (1997) Action thriller starring Pierce Brosnan and Linda Hamilton. The inhabitants of a volcano-side resort unwisely ignore a scientist's warning about its imminent eruption.

E4Plus1.uk.title: New: The Great Australian Bake Off
E4Plus1.uk.description: Brand new series - Bread Week: The remaining 11 bakers rise to a new challenge with breadsticks, a braided zopf, and scored and painted loaves. Who'll be toast this time? (S7 Ep2/10)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Marge the Meanie: Bart finds out that Marge was an accomplished prankster in middle school - and he's desperate for her to rediscover her mischievous ways. (S33 Ep20)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Meat Is Murder: Grampa's old friend Gus wants his help at the helm of his fast-food empire, leading to a Succession-style plot of corporate espionage. With John Lithgow. (S33 Ep21)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Treehouse of Horror XXIII: A black hole terrorises Springfield, Homer installs cameras in the house when things go bump in the night, and Bart travels back in time. (S24 Ep2/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Adventures in Baby-Getting: Marge gets a new car that's perfect for a family of five - but what if she decides she wants a family of six!? (S24 Ep3/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Venom
E4Plus1.uk.description: (2018) Dark sci-fi action starring Tom Hardy as Marvel's anti-hero. A reporter becomes inhabited by a ferocious alien that has its own ideas on how to behave. With Michelle Williams.
